title: tools.rs → domain modules pattern
content: When a single MCP handler file grows beyond 1000 lines, split it into per-domain modules under mcp/tools/. Each domain module has a `pub fn register(registry, engine)` function. The parent tools.rs becomes a ~30-line delegator calling each module. Domain names match tool prefixes (search.rs → wm_search.*, page.rs → wm_page.*). This keeps handler code discoverable and prevents merge conflicts.
